scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm electron:install:check && cargo build -p translunar-engine && pnpm build:desktop
scripts.contracts:generate: cargo run -p translunar-protocol --bin export-schema -- packages/contracts/src/protocol.schema.json && pnpm --filter @translunar/contracts generate
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages/contracts/src && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm toolchain:test && pnpm -r --if-present test && cargo test --workspace
scripts.test:formats: pnpm build:desktop && cargo build -p translunar-engine && node scripts/format-matrix.mjs
scripts.test:formats:linux: pnpm build:desktop && cargo build -p translunar-engine && ./scripts/linux-display.sh node scripts/format-matrix.mjs
scripts.test:job: pnpm build:desktop && cargo build -p translunar-engine && node scripts/editor-job-gate.mjs
scripts.test:job:linux: pnpm build:desktop && cargo build -p translunar-engine && ./scripts/linux-display.sh node scripts/editor-job-gate.mjs
scripts.test:intel: pnpm build:desktop && cargo build -p translunar-engine && node scripts/segment-intel-gate.mjs
scripts.test:intel:linux: pnpm build:desktop && cargo build -p translunar-engine && ./scripts/linux-display.sh node scripts/segment-intel-gate.mjs
scripts.test:actions: pnpm build:desktop && cargo build -p translunar-engine && node scripts/segment-actions-gate.mjs
scripts.test:actions:linux: pnpm build:desktop && cargo build -p translunar-engine && ./scripts/linux-display.sh node scripts/segment-actions-gate.mjs
scripts.test:suggest: pnpm build:desktop && cargo build -p translunar-engine && node scripts/suggest-gate.mjs
scripts.test:suggest:linux: pnpm build:desktop && cargo build -p translunar-engine && ./scripts/linux-display.sh node scripts/suggest-gate.mjs
scripts.test:review: pnpm build:desktop && cargo build -p translunar-engine && node scripts/review-gate.mjs
